entities.span: This spec builds the one door every AI model call walks through. A feature names a tier, "ai_scoring" or "ai_check", and gets back a validated structured result or a visible failure; it never names a vendor or a model.
The two tiers are configured in one checked in file to two different vendors, OpenAI for scoring and Google for the cross vendor check, so swapping a model later is an edit to that one file.
Every call passes through feature 10's usage gate first, using the tier name as the budget's call type
